title: Prongs are too short
text:
Prongs are too short. The design of the safety glide is not easy to use. It’s awkward to hold & the prongs are too short.
The removable cutting blades are positioned dead center, which also adds to the awkward usability. imo, they should be positioned toward the bottom of the lid for a smooth back & forth gliding motion, allowing user to apply the right amount of pressure for clean cutting rather than tearing.

The separate Colander basket inside the main basket is excellent. Storage for the blades on the bottom of the cover is clever & very helpful. I would suggest replacing the tiny julienne blade with a grating blade for cheese & zesting. The “large” julienne blade is actually a great size. The smaller one is just too small, unless you need toothpick sided veggie.
The concept is great. A little re-design would make this a useful, go-to kitchen tool.
